description:
Code and reproducibility data accompanying arXiv:2611.27507.

Includes frozen instances, raw hardware counts, native circuits and QPY registry, physical layouts, complete E01–E03 job-associated calibrations, exact references, supporting numerical archives and offline reproduction instructions with SHA-256 manifests. The article and supplemental manuscript are distributed separately through arXiv.
